ModMetaData.name: Rimworld Courier
ModMetaData.author: Akaired
ModMetaData.description:
Work as a courier. Friendly and neutral settlements post delivery jobs on a courier board: pick one up with a caravan, carry the sealed crate to its destination before the deadline and get paid in silver, sometimes goodwill, and chemfuel if you travel with vehicles or a shuttle.
- Jobs always fit the caravan that looks at them: free capacity, travel time, and the transport it uses (on foot, Odyssey shuttle, Vehicle Framework vehicles). - Food, medicine, drugs, textiles, raw resources, components, weapons, apparel, organs, prosthetics and bionics, books and furniture, each with a reason for the shipment: famine relief, a wedding feast, arms for a militia, a plague outbreak... - DLC content when active: imperial contracts (Royalty, Yeoman title required, better pay and sometimes honor), hemogen, genepacks, embryos and subcores (Biotech), relics of other faiths (Ideology), tomes, shards, bioferrite and disruptor flare packs (Anomaly). - Every accepted job is a quest with a live deadline, and every step comes with a letter. - Cargo travels in sealed, refrigerated crates: it cannot be eaten, burned as fuel or sold by accident, and it never spoils. - In an emergency you can break the seal and use the goods, but the contract fails and the sender remembers. The penalty grows with the value of the cargo. - If the sender turns hostile while you are on the road, the job still stands: deliver it and you still get paid. - No jobs are offered for or to hostile factions.
Optional support: Odyssey (passenger shuttle), Vehicle Framework.
